set.body: Consumer: PLS Neuro bd-01M1SATXX7S8X4ZDQ217NH11ND. Add a public linked-project catalog/load contract with checked stable root aliases, raw and derivative root declarations, and explicit derivative-to-source linkage. Every indexed file must retain root alias, root-relative BIDS path, and resolved location; manifest identity, sorting, inheritance, participant tables, and queries must remain deterministic and root-aware. Reject duplicate aliases, invalid or missing roots, path and logical-entity collisions, missing linkage, and ambiguous competing producers until a root alias plus pipeline is selected. Acceptance: JVM loader fixtures cover external derivative plus raw root, standalone derivative plus explicit source, two roots with the same producer/entities, reversed declaration and creation order, and all refusal cases; shared query/domain behavior passes JVM and Scala.js; preserve existing single-root load APIs.
set.title: Model linked raw and derivative BIDS roots with root-aware identity
